Tooltip.Unlocked:
Unlocked — players can freely change this.
Click to cycle to Soft Lock. Right-click to Player Lock. Alt+click to toggle Player Lock.
Tooltip.Soft:
Soft Locked — the GM's value is applied once. Players may override it permanently.
Click to cycle to Hard Lock. Right-click to unlock.
Tooltip.Hard:
Hard Locked — forced to the GM's value for all clients.
Click to cycle to Player Lock. Right-click to cycle to Soft Lock.
Tooltip.Player:
Player Locked — forced for players only. The GM keeps their own personal setting.
Click to unlock. Right-click to cycle to Hard Lock. Alt+click to toggle.
Tooltip.LockedByGM: This is locked by the GM.
Tooltip.SoftLockedByGM: This was set by the GM. You may change it if you wish.

Conflict.BannerText: Carolingian UI's "Enable client settings lock for core and other modules" is enabled alongside Nik's Settings Locks. To prevent duplicate icons and desynchronized enforcement, please disable it.
Conflict.ResolvedNotification: Disabled Carolingian UI generic locks. Nik's Settings Locks is managing your settings locks.
Conflict.ReadyWarn: Carolingian UI's generic settings lock is enabled. This conflicts with Nik's Settings Locks. Open the Lock Manager or Configure Settings to resolve it.

Notifications.HardLockBlocked: Cannot change "{name}" — it is locked by the GM.
Notifications.PlayerLockBlocked: Cannot change "{name}" — it is locked for players by the GM.
Notifications.ReloadForcing: Some locked settings require a reload to take effect. Reloading now…
Notifications.LocksEnforced: Locks have been updated by the GM.
Notifications.SoftLocksReenforcedOne: Re-enforced {count} soft lock. Players will receive the updated value on their next login.
Notifications.SoftLocksReenforcedMany: Re-enforced {count} soft locks. Players will receive the updated values on their next login.

Prompt.SoftLockUpdateDesc: You have changed the values of settings that are currently soft-locked. Do you want to update the soft lock so players receive the new values, or keep it as a local change for yourself only?

Settings.OpenManagerHint: Opens a dedicated window for managing all settings and control locks.
Settings.MinRoleHint: The minimum user role required to view and manage locks. Higher roles are always included (e.g. selecting Trusted Player also grants access to Assistant GMs and Game Masters).

Manager.OrphanedHint: These locks reference settings or controls that are no longer registered. This usually means the module was uninstalled or the setting was removed.
